en.text: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David with cedar trees, masons, and carpenters, to build him a house.

zhSimplified.text: 泰尔王希兰将香柏木运到大卫那里，又差遣使者和石匠、木匠给大卫建造宫殿。

zhTraditional.text: 泰爾王希蘭將香柏木運到大衛那裏，又差遣使者和石匠、木匠給大衛建造宮殿。

en.text: David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, for his kingdom was highly exalted, for his people Israel’s sake.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫就知道耶和华坚立他作以色列王，又为自己的民以色列，使他的国兴旺。

zhTraditional.text: 大衛就知道耶和華堅立他作以色列王，又為自己的民以色列，使他的國興旺。

en.text: David took more wives in Jerusalem, and David became the father of more sons and daughters.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫在耶路撒冷又立后妃，又生儿女。

zhTraditional.text: 大衛在耶路撒冷又立后妃，又生兒女。

en.text: These are the names of the children whom he had in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,

zhSimplified.text: 在耶路撒冷所生的众子是沙母亚、朔罢、拿单、所罗门、

zhTraditional.text: 在耶路撒冷所生的眾子是沙母亞、朔罷、拿單、所羅門、

zhSimplified.text: 以利沙玛、比利雅大、以利法列。 （撒下5·17—25）

zhTraditional.text: 以利沙瑪、比利雅大、以利法列。 （撒下5‧17－25）

en.text: When the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went out against them.

zhSimplified.text: 非利士人听见大卫受膏作以色列众人的王，非利士众人就上来寻索大卫。大卫听见，就出去迎敌。

zhTraditional.text: 非利士人聽見大衛受膏作以色列眾人的王，非利士眾人就上來尋索大衛。大衛聽見，就出去迎敵。

en.text: Now the Philistines had come and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim.

zhSimplified.text: 非利士人来了，布散在利乏音谷。

zhTraditional.text: 非利士人來了，布散在利乏音谷。

en.text: David inquired of God, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?” The LORD said to him, “Go up; for I will deliver them into your hand.”

zhSimplified.text: 大卫求问 神，说：「我可以上去攻打非利士人吗？你将他们交在我手里吗？」耶和华说：「你可以上去，我必将他们交在你手里。」

zhTraditional.text: 大衛求問上帝，說：「我可以上去攻打非利士人嗎？你將他們交在我手裏嗎？」耶和華說：「你可以上去，我必將他們交在你手裏。」

en.text: So they came up to Baal Perazim, and David defeated them there. David said, God has broken my enemies by my hand, like waters breaking out. Therefore they called the name of that place Baal Perazim.

footnotes.text: 14:11 “Baal Perazim” means “The Lord who breaks out”.

zhSimplified.text: 非利士人来到巴力·毗拉心，大卫在那里杀败他们。大卫说：「 神借我的手冲破敌人，如同水冲去一般」；因此称那地方为巴力·毗拉心。

zhTraditional.text: 非利士人來到巴力‧毗拉心，大衛在那裏殺敗他們。大衛說：「上帝藉我的手沖破敵人，如同水沖去一般」；因此稱那地方為巴力‧毗拉心。

en.text: They left their gods there; and David gave a command, and they were burned with fire.

zhSimplified.text: 非利士人将神像撇在那里，大卫吩咐人用火焚烧了。

zhTraditional.text: 非利士人將神像撇在那裏，大衛吩咐人用火焚燒了。

en.text: The Philistines made another raid in the valley.

zhSimplified.text: 非利士人又布散在利乏音谷。

zhTraditional.text: 非利士人又布散在利乏音谷。

en.text: David inquired again of God; and God said to him, “You shall not go up after them. Turn away from them, and come on them opposite the mulberry trees.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫又求问 神。 神说：「不要一直地上去，要转到他们后头，从桑林对面攻打他们。

zhTraditional.text: 大衛又求問上帝。上帝說：「不要一直地上去，要轉到他們後頭，從桑林對面攻打他們。

en.text: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then go out to battle; for God has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”

zhSimplified.text: 你听见桑树梢上有脚步的声音，就要出战，因为 神已经在你前头去攻打非利士人的军队。」

zhTraditional.text: 你聽見桑樹梢上有腳步的聲音，就要出戰，因為上帝已經在你前頭去攻打非利士人的軍隊。」

en.text: David did as God commanded him; and they attacked the army of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.

zhSimplified.text: 大卫就遵着 神所吩咐的，攻打非利士人的军队，从基遍直到基色。

zhTraditional.text: 大衛就遵着上帝所吩咐的，攻打非利士人的軍隊，從基遍直到基色。

en.text: The fame of David went out into all lands; and the LORD brought the fear of him on all nations.

zhSimplified.text: 于是大卫的名传扬到列国，耶和华使列国都惧怕他。

zhTraditional.text: 於是大衛的名傳揚到列國，耶和華使列國都懼怕他。
